steps.what: skim milk powder, tryptone, yeast extract, dextrose and agar
steps.note: Per litre: 28 g skim milk powder, 5 g tryptone, 2.5 g yeast extract, 1 g dextrose and 15 g agar.

steps.name: autoclave apart
steps.note: The agar solution and the milk solution are autoclaved in separate flasks, never mixed before.

steps.what: the molten agar, into the stirring milk
steps.note: Poured in slowly, with the milk stirred all the while.

processing.text: The recipe is for skim milk powder; the separate sterilising comes from an OpenWetware protocol with a different agar recipe (LB and milk).

sources.text: The ingredients from Microbe Online; the separate autoclaving, combining and pouring from OpenWetware. Neither gives an autoclave temperature or time.
